url: in the url field; enter the base url of the website you want to scrape and the sublinks will be automatically scraped; in the depth field enter the depth of the links you want to scrape; and in the excluded_sublinks field enter the sublinks you want to exclude from scraping. For example; if you want to scrape all links except those that contain 'faculty'; 'employee'; 'list'; 'Downloads'; 'ScholarshipAwardees'; or 'MedalHolders' in their URL; you would enter: faculty|employee|list|Downloads|ScholarshipAwardees|MedalHolders. If you want to scrape all links; leave the excluded_sublinks field empty.
